subject: CS -> Eng: Feature enablement kickoff (streaming, toolcalls, structured outputs)
messages:
From: Mira Patel <mira.patel@clearpath.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: salesops@clearpath.ai
Date: Fri, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff request: streaming + tool-calling + JSON outputs

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the ClearPath team is excited about Redwood's low-latency streaming and the tool-calling primitives. We pulled together a short list of expected integration points and constraints (attached). High level asks:

- Real-time transcript streaming for our contact-center use case (sub-250ms token latency)
- Function/tool calling to execute lookups (patient lookup, authorization check)
- Structured JSON outputs that map to our downstream event schema (we included a draft in tab 2 of the spreadsheet)

We're aiming to start a technical kickoff next week. Can Redwood share a short mutual action plan and a list of pre-kickoff artifacts you need from our side (sample payloads, API keys, security questionnaire answers)?

Proposed times: Tue 2027-05-04 or Wed 2027-05-05, 10-12 PT.

Attached: ClearPath_API_requirements.xlsx

Thanks,
Mira
Account Lead, ClearPath AI
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Mira Patel <mira.patel@clearpath.ai>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 01 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff request: streaming + tool-calling + JSON outputs

Hi Mira — great to hear, and thanks for the detailed spreadsheet. I'm looping in Camila (CS lead) and Marissa (solutions eng) so we can scope the kickoff. Quick response below with what we'll bring and what we need from you pre-kickoff.

What Redwood will prepare before kickoff:
- Mutual Action Plan draft (I'll attach a one-pager)
- Pre-configured demo workspace focusing on streaming + toolcalls
- Suggested JSON schema crosswalk and example mapping to your tab 2
- Security primer (SOC2 scope, data retention defaults)

We need from ClearPath prior to the call:
- Sample event payloads (3-5 examples) and one canonical event you expect in production
- A contact for network/VPC questions if you plan to use Private deployment
- Answers to the short security checklist (I can send a link)

Proposed kickoff: Wed 2027-05-05 at 10:30 AM PT — does that work?

I'll attach our CS-Handoff-Checklist and a lightweight Mutual Action Plan. If Wed doesn't work, we can do Tue 11:00 AM PT.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: CS-Handoff-Checklist.pdf; Mutual_Action_Plan.docx
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:15:00 -07:00

Thanks Tessa — quick internal split of responsibilities so we're aligned before the customer call: 

- Camila (CS): kickoff agenda, success criteria, mutual action plan owner
- Marissa (Solutions Eng): demo workspace, example schemas, integration runbook
- Ben (SRE/Infra): latency targets, autoscaling guidance, KV-cache recommendations

Pre-kickoff action items (owners and ETA):
- Tessa: send the short security checklist link and HubSpot record (EOD today)
- Marissa: prepare a demo that shows streaming + a mock toolcall (POC) and the JSON mapping (EOD Tue)
- Ben: write a short note on quantization/throughput tradeoffs for their use case (EOD Tue)

I'll draft a 30-min kickoff agenda and share. Also suggest we include a one-page "schema crosswalk" so ClearPath sees exact field-level mappings.

--Camila
